author: Seung Wook
problem: In a hotel the floors above ground are numbered 1, 2, 3, ... and the basement floors -1, -2, ..., with no floor 0. Return how many floors the lift moves going from floor start to floor end.
bug_description: Only allows for the missing floor 0 when going up (start < 0 < end), so a trip down from above ground into the basement counts one floor too many.

comments.accurate: Floors the lift moves between start and end in a building with no floor 0
comments.wrong_behavior: Floors moved, with one taken off for the missing floor 0 when the lift leaves the basement
comments.wrong_location: Ground-floor check verified; check the distance is taken as an absolute value
